Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:

3a7cab67...@news.mad.ttd.net...


READ THE CARDS
when they say "vampire gets + something", you can add the bonus, like in
horrid form or Fire in the blood. When they say "vampire can prevent 1
damage", this also stack up (for horrid form or unflinching persistence).
When it says "hand damage is now X", this is not cumulative, so it would be
foolish (or desperate cycling) to add other cards. some cards also prevent
you from stacking by card text. that's that simple.

reyda

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
1gan...@teleline.es (Geb) writes:

> hello all
>
> if i play combat cards they add together?

Depends on the card. In general, if it says + or gives you the option
to do something several times, you can do it several times or add them
together.

>, ie: two horrid forms to +2
> strength,

Yes.

> and prevent 2 points of damage in combat (in superior),

Yes.

> or 2
> torn signpost to 6 strength (in superior both) ....

No.

The first one sets your strength to 3.
The second one sets your strength to 3 again. It doesn't stack.

Use Fists of Death or Increased Strength if you want to do that
(depending on your deck).
